hook: Only 4 of 19 major economies meet emergency backstop rules for failing banks.

sections.voiceover: Only 4 of 19 major economies meet emergency backstop rules for failing banks.
On October 9, 2026, the Financial Stability Board published a peer review report on public sector backstop funding mechanisms. Which eight members landed on the materially non-compliant list?
b_roll: World map with highlighted financial centers

sections.voiceover: Yet Switzerland and the European Union Banking Union landed among eight materially non-compliant members.

Only the United States, United Kingdom, Japan, and Hong Kong fully met resolution standards. Those four economies avoided the non-compliant rating entirely. The Financial Stability Board adopted these rules back in 2011.

text_overlay.text: US, UK, Japan, Hong Kong compliant

sections.voiceover: The Financial Stability Board reviewed all 19 economies in its report.
